'''Aurek Company''' was a company in the [[Second Battalion (Fifth Infantry)|Second Battalion]] of the [[Fifth Infantry]], a division in the [[Imperial Army (Sith Empire)|Imperial Army]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. It was stationed with [[Besh Company|Besh]] and [[Cresh Company|Cresh Companies]] on [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]], where the entire battalion was under the command of [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Tyrus (major)|Tyrus]], and the three companies were tasked with fighting the [[Balmorran resistance]] in the [[Broken Valley]].
